mainEntity.name: What is fat grafting to the buttocks?

acceptedAnswer.text: A procedure that uses a patient's own fat to enhance buttock shape and volume.
When performed by a trained plastic surgeon following established safety guidelines, it is considered safe.
Surviving fat is permanent if body weight remains stable.

mainEntity.name: Will I lose volume over time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Some early fat loss is expected; final results stabilise by 3–4 months.
Discomfort is usually mild to moderate and managed with medication.

mainEntity.name: Can it be combined with other procedures?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, commonly with liposuction or body contouring surgeries.
